title: Compute elastic moduli from Lamb mode frequencies
action: Write a Python script that reads the sample parameters (provided inline in the instructions) for seven MSMSP samples. For each sample, numerically solve the radial Lamb transcendental equation for the l=0,n=1 mode (assuming Poisson ratio ν=0.17) to obtain longitudinal sound velocity sL and transverse sound velocity sT. Then compute bulk modulus B = ρ sL² − (4/3) G and shear modulus G = ρ sT². Output a CSV file with one row per sample and columns: sample, sL_km_s, sT_km_s, B_GPa, G_GPa.
description: CSV containing the computed longitudinal and transverse sound velocities (km/s) and the bulk and shear moduli (GPa) for each mesoporous silica sphere sample.
output_schema: CSV with header: sample, sL_km_s, sT_km_s, B_GPa, G_GPa. Rows for samples: 1A, 1B, 1C, bare_1050, 2A, 2B, bare_620. All numeric values are floats.
